name: freeq-foundry
description: An experiment in autonomous institutional formation

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/policy packages/projections packages/capabilities packages/governance packages/event-store packages/gateway packages/agents packages/observability packages/controller apps/foundry
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm -r run test
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/protocol packages/policy packages/projections packages/capabilities packages/governance packages/event-store packages/gateway packages/agents packages/observability packages/controller apps/foundry && pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist *.tsbuildinfo
